#!/bin/bash
# usage: process.sh SHARD -> out/SHARD.sum (exit 2 on a malformed row)
shard=$1
mkdir -p out
awk -F, -v shard="$shard" '
  NR == 1 { next }
  $2 !~ /^[0-9]+$/ { printf "%s: line %d: bad amount %s\n", shard, NR, $2 > "/dev/stderr"; bad = 1; exit 2 }
  { sum += $2 }
  END { if (!bad) print sum }
' "data/$shard.csv" > "out/$shard.sum.tmp" || { rm -f "out/$shard.sum.tmp"; exit 2; }
mv "out/$shard.sum.tmp" "out/$shard.sum"
